SortableGroup.description: Lets items move between the SortableRoots inside it. It owns every list's order, by each root's `listId`, runs the drag across them, and holds the keyboard instructions and the live region for all of them. Renders a `<div>`.

props.value: Each list's order: an object from each root's `listId` to the ids of its items. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the lists.
props.defaultValue: Each list's order at first, when it isn't controlled. Render the items from the `value` each root's context gives.
props.onValueChange: Called once per drop that changes an order, with every list's new order and the drag's details (`id`, `from` and `to` as `{ list, index }`, `reason`). It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the lists show the new order until it has run, then the value you hold (your guess, or the old order until you write the new one).
props.disabled: Whether nothing in the group can be dragged.
props.messages: The texts announced while an item is moved, its handles' instructions and role description, over the English defaults. In a group these are used for every list; the roots' own `messages` are not.
props.onSortStart: Called when an item is picked up, with the drag's details. In a group, only the group's callbacks are called.
props.onSortMove: Called each time the place the dragged item would land changes, with that place as `to`.
props.onSortEnd: Called on a drop, whether or not the order changed, with where the item landed as `to`.
props.onSortCancel: Called when a drag is called off (Escape, a cancelled pointer, or focus leaving the handle mid-drag) and nothing moved.

dataAttributes.data-dragging: Present while an item in one of its lists is dragged.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the group is disabled.

SortableRoot.description: One list: a `<ul>` that owns the order of its items, or, in a SortableGroup, shows the group's order for its `listId`. Render the items from the order, in that order: the list never moves them itself. Beside it (or, in a group, inside the group) sits a visually hidden element with the keyboard instructions and an assertive live region.

props.value: The order: the ids of the items. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the list.
props.defaultValue: The order at first, when it isn't controlled. The items then come from the order in the context: a small component inside the root reads `use sortable` and loops over `value`.
props.onValueChange: Called once per drop that changes the order, with the new order and the drag's details (`id`, `from` and `to` as `{ list, index }`, `reason`). Nothing is called while an item is carried. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the list shows the new order until it has run, then the value you hold (your guess, or the old order until you write the new one).
props.listId: In a SortableGroup, which of the group's lists this is: a key of the group's `value`.
props.orientation: Whether the items run down (`vertical`) or along the inline direction (`horizontal`, right to left in a right-to-left page). It picks the arrow keys that move an item and the axis it is measured along.
props.disabled: Whether nothing in the list can be dragged and nothing can be dropped into it.
props.messages: The texts announced while an item is moved (`pickedUp`, `moved`, `dropped`, `cancelled`: functions of the item's label, its position, the list's size and label), the handles' `instructions` and `roleDescription`, over the English defaults.
props.onSortStart: Called when an item is picked up, with the drag's details. Not called for a root in a group: give the group the callbacks.
props.onSortMove: Called each time the place the dragged item would land changes, with that place as `to`.
props.onSortEnd: Called on a drop, whether or not the order changed, with where the item landed as `to`.
props.onSortCancel: Called when a drag is called off (Escape, a cancelled pointer, or focus leaving the handle mid-drag) and nothing moved.

dataAttributes.data-dragging: While one of its items is dragged: `pointer` or `keyboard`, for what is dragging it.
dataAttributes.data-drop-target: Present while the dragged item would land in this list.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the list is disabled.

SortableItem.description: An item, a `<li>`, identified by its `id`. It is never moved in the DOM during a drag: the dragged item and the items making way for it get an offset in CSS variables, which your `translate` applies. Without a SortableHandle inside it, the item is its own handle: it takes focus (`tabindex="0"`), is described by the instructions, and a press anywhere on it drags, except on a control inside it. A touch on such an item drags after a long press, so a swipe still scrolls.

props.id: The item's id in the list's order. Unique across a group.
props.disabled: Whether this item can't be dragged. It still makes way for others.

dataAttributes.data-dragging: On the item being dragged: `pointer` or `keyboard`. Animate a keyboard step with a transition; a pointer drag is followed as it is.
dataAttributes.data-shifted: Present on an item that makes way for the dragged one. Give these a `transition` on `translate`: the attribute goes as the drop changes the order, so nothing animates back.
dataAttributes.data-drop-target: On the item the dragged one would land beside: `before` it, or `after` it when that is the end of the list. For a drop indicator instead of a gap.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the item or its list is disabled.

cssVariables.--sortable-x: The item's horizontal offset in px: how far the dragged item has been carried, or how far an item steps aside. `0px` at rest.
cssVariables.--sortable-y: The item's vertical offset in px, the same way.

SortableHandle.description: A `<button>` that drags its item: Space or Enter picks the item up, and a press drags it once it moves a few pixels (a press that doesn't move is a click). It has `touch-action: none`, the messages' `roleDescription` as `aria-roledescription`, the instructions as its description, and `aria-pressed` while its item is dragged. Give it an `aria-label`. Disabled with its item or list.

dataAttributes.data-dragging: Present while its item is dragged.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when its item or list is disabled.
